mission_10: Masterful! You have completed the Quantum Machine Learning chapter by building a fully integrated quantum ML framework. Your system seamlessly combines classical neural network layers with quantum circuits, managing both quantum and classical parameters in a unified training loop. The mini-batch training with stochastic gradient estimation enables practical optimization on simulated quantum hardware. The framework tracks loss and accuracy across epochs, providing full visibility into the training process. From quantum circuit simulation to variational algorithms, from quantum kernels to hybrid models, from data encoding to optimization — you now possess a comprehensive understanding of quantum machine learning. While fault-tolerant quantum computers remain a future goal, the algorithms and architectures you've implemented represent the cutting edge of what's possible with today's quantum hardware and tomorrow's quantum advantage.
